label: Confirmed Deaths
source: OCHA Situation Report #34 (27 Aug 2026), figures as of 24 Aug
contestNote: Toll has risen steadily across successive SitReps; treat as a point-in-time figure, not a final count.

label: Official Injured (Frozen)
source: OCHA Situation Reports (frozen since 5 Jul SitRep)
contestNote: Static since 5 July even as deaths kept rising; distinct from the larger, growing cumulative hospital-care count.

label: Cumulative Hospital/Medical Care
source: Government press briefing, Jorge Rodríguez (24 Aug 2026), via Diario Libre

label: Direct Economic Damage (UNDRR)
source: UN Office for Disaster Risk Reduction
contestNote: UNDP's narrower housing/economic estimate puts damage at $6.7B (~6% of GDP) instead; a separate World Bank assessment (23 Jul 2026) put direct physical damage at $19.6B, with total reconstruction cost (incl. debris removal + resilient rebuilding) approaching $50B.

label: Humanitarian Response Plan Funded
deltaNote: $931M required for 2026; roughly $566–627M funding gap remained as of mid-summer reporting.

label: Homes Under Repair (Venezuela Rises Plan)
deltaNote: Nationwide repair/rehab program (Plan Venezuela Renace) reports 13,890 homes under active repair or rehabilitation nationwide; separately, at the two-month mark (24 Aug) the government said 335 homes had been fully delivered and 1,001 recovered, benefiting 3,503 people, with 4,000+ more promised by year-end.
